module.title: Lakehouse, Analytical Data Products and Research Releases
module.business_purpose: Separates raw, standardized, curated and research-ready data while preserving lineage, quality contracts, de-identification and controlled release. Operational databases are not queried as an ad hoc warehouse; transformations are explicit, versioned and reproducible.
